ai_review.summary: Mostly solid soundboard recording with a reasonably well‑played show; one listener reported playback failure.
ai_review.review: The second review praises the concert as a nicely played set captured on a good‑sounding board, highlighting Stephen Stills’ guest spots. However, the first reviewer simply notes “I'M BROKEN” and a “NO WORKIE” title, indicating they could not get the file to play. Overall sentiment is mixed because the performance is praised while the usability of the recording is questioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave five stars, but one points out a playback problem; the show itself is described as reasonably well played and the board sound good, leading to a solid rating with moderate confidence.
